title: Elixir/Phoenix Developer
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for Elixir/Phoenix Developer: Build fault-tolerant real-time applications with Elixir, OTP, Phoenix, LiveView, Ecto, testing, and observability.

tree.name: Elixir Language Fundamentals
tree.description: Master the core syntax, functional programming paradigms, and foundational concepts of the Elixir language to build robust and maintainable applications.

resources.title: Learn Elixir 0-60 in one Hour - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Syntax, Data Types & Pattern Matching
children.description: Understand basic syntax, core data types (atoms, lists, maps, tuples), and the power of pattern matching in Elixir.

children.name: Functional Programming Concepts
children.description: Grasp immutability, pure functions, recursion, higher-order functions, and pipe operator for clean and declarative code.

resources.title: Functional Programming for the Object-Oriented Programmer

children.name: Modules, Functions & Organizers
children.description: Learn to define modules, functions, use `defp` for private functions, and organize code with `import`, `alias`, `require`.

resources.title: Elixir School: Aliases, Imports and Requires
Elixir Tutorial for Beginners - 3 - Modules, Functions, Recursion & Pattern Matching
Elixir Tutorial for Beginners - 4 - Code Organization & Imports

children.name: Enum Module & Comprehensions
children.description: Effectively work with collections using the powerful `Enum` module and leverage list/map comprehensions for concise data transformations.

children.name: Error Handling & Control Flow
children.description: Implement robust error handling strategies using `case`, `with`, `try/catch`, `raise`, `exit`, and understand different types of errors.

resources.title: Error Handling in Elixir - Try, Rescue, Catch, Throw and Exit

children.name: Mix Build Tool & Escript
children.description: Understand Mix for project management, dependencies, tasks, and building executable Escripts.

resources.title: Elixir Tutorial (2020) - Mix, IEx, and Project Structure

tree.name: OTP and Concurrency Model
tree.description: Dive deep into Elixir's concurrency model based on the Erlang Virtual Machine (BEAM) and the Open Telecom Platform (OTP) for building fault-tolerant and distributed systems.

resources.title: Learn You Some Erlang for Great Good! (Covers OTP fundamentals)

children.name: Elixir Processes & Message Passing
children.description: Learn about lightweight processes, message passing, `spawn`, `send`, `receive` for concurrent execution.

resources.title: Elixir Crash Course - Learn Elixir in 2 hours!

children.name: GenServer Behavior
children.description: Master `GenServer` for building robust server-client applications, managing state, and handling asynchronous requests.

resources.title: GenServer in Elixir - Build a Simple Key-Value Store
Learn GenServer in Elixir: The COMPLETE Guide (from basic to advanced)

children.name: Agent & Task Behaviors
children.description: Utilize `Agent` for simple state management and `Task` for running one-off, asynchronous computations.

resources.title: Elixir Language: Concurrency with Agent and Task
Elixir Concurrency with Task.async and Task.await

children.name: Supervisors & Supervision Trees
children.description: Implement fault-tolerant systems using `Supervisor` to manage process lifecycles and recovery strategies.

children.name: OTP Applications & Releases
children.description: Structure your projects as OTP applications and learn to build standalone releases for deployment with `Mix Release`.

tree.name: Phoenix Framework Essentials
tree.description: Get started with the Phoenix web framework, understanding its structure, MVC pattern, routing, and basic request/response cycle for building powerful web applications.

resources.title: Phoenix Framework REST API Crash Course - Introduction + Full Elixir API Tutorial (Caleb Curry)
Learn Phoenix Framework - Full Course for Beginners

children.name: Phoenix Project Setup
children.description: Set up a new Phoenix project, understand its directory structure, and basic configuration.

resources.title: Phoenix Framework Crash Course | Build a Web App with Elixir & Phoenix

children.name: Routing & Controllers
children.description: Define routes, create controllers, handle HTTP requests, and manage request parameters.

resources.title: Phoenix Framework Routing Tutorial | Phoenix Framework Crash Course Part 2
Phoenix 1.7 Quick Start: Routing and Controllers

children.name: Plugs & Middleware
children.description: Understand and utilize Plugs for building modular and composable web request pipelines, including custom plugs and the Plug specification.

resources.title: Building a Custom Plug in Elixir Phoenix - Plugs 101

children.name: Views & EEx Templates
children.description: Work with Phoenix views, EEx templates, layouts, and helpers for rendering dynamic HTML.

resources.title: Phoenix Framework Views and Templates Tutorial | How to build a custom Layout | Elixir

children.name: Contexts & Application Structure
children.description: Organize business logic using Phoenix Contexts for a clear, maintainable, and domain-driven application architecture.

resources.title: Phoenix Contexts Explained: What are they, and how do you use them?

children.name: Static Assets & Asset Pipeline
children.description: Manage static files, integrate with asset bundlers like esbuild, and understand the asset pipeline for efficient front-end delivery.

resources.title: Modern JavaScript Tooling & Build Processes (Webpack, Parcel, Vite, Rollup)

children.name: Introduction to Phoenix Channels
children.description: Understand the basics of Phoenix Channels for real-time communication, including topics and pub/sub patterns.

resources.title: Build a Simple Chat App with Phoenix Channels

tree.name: Data Persistence with Ecto
tree.description: Learn how to interact with databases using Ecto, Elixir's powerful data mapping and query tool, enabling robust data management in your applications.

Elixir Crash Course | Build a ToDo App with Phoenix and LiveView

children.name: Ecto Schemas & Migrations
children.description: Define data structures with Ecto schemas and manage database changes using migrations.

children.description: Master `Changesets` for data validation, casting, and manipulation before persisting to the database.

resources.title: Elixir Ecto Changesets - Phoenix Framework Tutorial

children.name: Ecto Queries & Repositories
children.description: Build powerful queries using Ecto.Query and interact with your database via Ecto.Repo.

resources.title: Ecto for Beginners Part 1 - Elixir Tutorial
Ecto in Phoenix - Database Interaction with Ecto in Elixir

children.name: Ecto Associations
children.description: Handle relationships between schemas (has_many, belongs_to, has_one, many_to_many) for complex data models.

children.name: Transactions & Ecto.Multi
children.description: Ensure data consistency with database transactions and compose multiple Ecto operations atomically using `Ecto.Multi`.

resources.title: Ecto Multi - Group Multiple Database Operations into an Atomic Transaction in Elixir - Part 1

children.name: Embedded Schemas & Custom Types
children.description: Work with embedded schemas for complex data structures within a single record and define custom Ecto types for specific data representations.

tree.name: Real-time UIs with Phoenix LiveView
tree.description: Master Phoenix LiveView to build rich, interactive user interfaces with server-rendered HTML and minimal JavaScript, creating highly responsive web applications.

resources.title: Learning Elixir and Phoenix LiveView | Claudey With a Chance of DevOps (Jason Smith)

children.name: LiveView Lifecycle & Interactions
children.description: Understand the LiveView lifecycle (`mount`, `handle_event`, `render`), state management, and basic user interactions.

resources.title: Phoenix LiveView Tutorial for Beginners (Basic example)
Getting Started with Phoenix LiveView (Part 1 - Phoenix LiveView From Scratch)

children.name: LiveComponents & Layouts
children.description: Create reusable LiveComponents, manage contexts, and utilize layouts for consistent UI.

resources.title: Building a reusable LiveView Component (Learn Phoenix LiveView)

children.name: Forms & Validation in LiveView
children.description: Handle forms, implement real-time client-side and server-side validation using Ecto Changesets in LiveView.

resources.title: LiveView Forms - Building a CRUD app in LiveView Part 2
Phoenix LiveView Validation with Ecto Changesets

children.name: File Uploads & Streaming
children.description: Implement direct-to-S3 or server-backed file uploads and leverage LiveView's streaming capabilities for efficient data display.

resources.title: Upload Files with Phoenix LiveView and S3 Presigned URLs
Phoenix LiveView Streaming: Insert, Update & Delete Elements

children.name: Authentication & Authorization with LiveView
children.description: Implement user authentication and authorization logic within LiveView applications, including session management and access control.

children.name: JavaScript Interoperability
children.description: Integrate custom JavaScript using `phx-hook`, `JS.exec`, and manage client-side features that LiveView doesn't cover.

resources.title: Phoenix LiveView: JS Commands for Front-End Interaction

tree.name: Testing, Debugging & Quality Assurance
tree.description: Implement robust testing strategies, effective debugging techniques, and best practices for code quality in Elixir and Phoenix applications to ensure reliability.

resources.title: Elixir Unit Testing with ExUnit - The Simplest Introduction
Elixir Debugging 101: pry, dbg, IO.inspect and Observer

children.name: ExUnit: Unit & Integration Testing
children.description: Write comprehensive unit tests for Elixir modules and integration tests for application logic using ExUnit.

children.description: Learn techniques for isolating units of code during testing using mocking, stubbing, and dependency injection patterns in Elixir.

children.name: Testing Phoenix & LiveView
children.description: Learn to test Phoenix controllers, views, channels, and specifically LiveView components and interactions.

resources.title: Testing a Phoenix LiveView Application - Phoenix 1.7

children.name: Ecto Database Testing
children.description: Implement database testing strategies, including transactional tests and seeding data for tests.

resources.title: Effective Database Testing with Ecto - Joe White - ElixirConf 2017
Phoenix LiveView Testing with Ecto Integration

children.name: Code Quality & Static Analysis
children.description: Utilize tools like `mix format` for consistent code styling and `Credo` for static analysis to enforce coding standards and identify potential issues.

resources.title: Elixir Mix Format - A Guide to Consistent Code Style

children.name: Debugging & Observability Tools
children.description: Utilize `IEx`, `IO.inspect`, `Logger`, and the Erlang `Observer` for effective debugging and runtime inspection.

resources.title: Using the Erlang Observer in Elixir
ElixirConf EU 2021 - Elixir Debugging: The Good Parts - Alex Koutmos
Explore your Elixir App with Erlang Observer

tree.name: Deployment, Operations & Observability
tree.description: Learn to deploy, monitor, and maintain Elixir/Phoenix applications in production environments, focusing on reliability, security, and performance at scale.

resources.title: Deploy a Phoenix App to Gigalixir in 2023

children.description: Explore various deployment methods like releases, Docker, cloud platforms (Gigalixir, Fly.io, Kubernetes) and understand their trade-offs.

resources.title: How to Deploy a Phoenix App to Gigalixir in 2023

Deploying Elixir/Phoenix Apps with GitHub Actions | ElixirConf 2022

The Telemetry Library with Benwilson. ElixirConf US 2021

resources.title: Optimizing Elixir Applications at Scale - Todd Resudek - ElixirConf 2018
Faster Ecto Queries - Andrew Ek - ElixirConfEU 2021

children.name: Security Best Practices

Elixir - GenStage & Broadway - Part 1: Intro to GenStage
How to Build a Simple Distributed Application in Elixir

Phoenix Framework Full Course for Beginners
